column1: # Hand-read corrections for shape classes the OCR consensus cannot reach.
# The hash is checked against the class bitmap at build time; if the clustering
# changes and a class no longer matches, the override is skipped with a warning
# rather than silently applied to the wrong shape.  Get hashes with:
#   python3 -c "import pickle; from pipeline import class_hash; \
# These came out of `make review`: both OCR models strip a macron that is fused
# to the letter it sits on, so the class reads as a bare letter.  flag.py finds
# them by noticing two base clusters that vote the same letter where one is
# i with the macron fused to the stem: dīwān, dakaitī, rājñī, līhtan, tīd, dīc
# Greek geōgraphikos / geōgraphos / geōgraphia: "eog" merged, macron on the o
# Hindi dakaitī: "it" merged, so the t is otherwise lost
# Old Norse bǫllr / bǫrkr: "bo" merged, ogonek under the o
